name: health-weekly-journal
description: Assemble the week's health entries and report what routine care is now due.

week_of.help: Monday of the week to assemble (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty uses the week just ended.

metadata.when_not_to_use: never for medical interpretation — this assembles a log, nothing more

config.prompt: Assemble the health entries for the week of {{inputs.week_of}} (empty = the week just ended). List the days with no entry rather than averaging over them.
Given {{nodes.assemble.output}}, report which routine checkups are due or overdue, oldest first, showing the arithmetic. Do not interpret anything medically.
